title: card-loop fix_card result v1
description: Stage `fix_card` (design D4 TRIAGE ours_wrong -> FIX; D13 fix gate). The worker changed a card's YAML spec / card data in its worktree to remove a divergence triaged `ours_wrong`. The fix gate (driver) requires: `citation` (general_rule.pdf section, official ruling `qa:<Q-number>`, or DCGO `file:line`), `tests` that fail at the pinned base and pass with the fix (the gate re-runs them both ways), and a green scoped `cards_behavioral`. `test_result_lines` are verbatim runner summary lines (honesty contract). `gaps`: substrate the fix turned out to need (non-empty => park instead of fixing). Strict-mode compatible.

tests.description: Regression tests that fail before the fix and pass after it.

citation.description: Why the old behaviour was wrong: rule = general_rule.pdf section (e.g. `16-36`), ruling = `qa:<Q-number>`, dcgo = `<path>.cs:<line>`.
